meta.title: Modular ERP
meta.subtitle: Sales, inventory across three warehouses, purchasing with approvals, production, accounting, receivables and payroll for a fictitious company. What you do in one module shows up in the others.
meta.sampleHint: Fictitious company and figures generated for the demo (January–September 2026). DIAN, banks and WhatsApp are simulated.
meta.seoTitle: ERP demo: sales, inventory, purchasing and accounting
meta.seoDescription: Try a modular ERP with sample data: quote, order and invoice that reduce stock and post the journal entry, purchase orders with approvals, bank reconciliation, receivables aging, payroll and production. DIAN validation is simulated.

topbar.workDate: Open period: September 2026 · new transactions are dated {date}
topbar.trmNote: USD converted at a fixed sample exchange rate of {trm}
topbar.savedLocally: Your changes are saved only in this browser
topbar.resetBody: This deletes the quotes, invoices, orders, payments and other changes you made in this demo, and brings back the original data.

flow.title: End-to-end walkthrough
flow.intro: Each step is checked when you actually do it in the demo. Click a step to go to its module.
flow.done: You completed the walkthrough! Look at how the indicators above changed.

invoice.text: Turn a quote into an order and invoice it: stock goes down and the journal entry is posted.

reorder.text: Create a purchase order from a reorder-point alert (or from MRP).

approve.text: Approve your PO (purchasing manager and, above COP 20M, management) and receive the goods.

reconcile.text: Reconcile a bank statement line: a customer's PSE payment or the 4x1000 tax.

ledger.text: See the automatic entries for your invoice and the updated financial statements.

entryDesc.taxVat: VAT payment for the two-month period ending {month}

accounts.6145: Cost of sales · transport and storage

sales.title: Sales: quote → order → invoice
sales.subtitle: Invoicing checks warehouse stock, reduces inventory, posts the journal entry and moves the invoice to receivables.
sales.empty: There are no sales documents in this period.
sales.periodSwitched: We switched the period to September 2026 so you can see the transaction.

toasts.invoiced: Invoice {doc} issued. Simulated DIAN validation in progress…
toasts.credited: Credit note {doc} recorded: the goods went back to the warehouse.

shortage.title: Not enough stock in {wh} to invoice:
shortage.go: Go to Inventory to transfer or buy

dian.note: In the demo the DIAN response is simulated. In your project the invoice is sent to DIAN through an authorized technology provider and delivered to the customer.

trace.title: What this document generated
trace.sale: Journal entry {doc} (revenue, VAT, cost of sales and inventory)
trace.stock: Stock issued from the {wh} warehouse (see the stock card in Inventory)

creditNote.title: Credit note for {doc}
creditNote.body: The whole invoice is voided: the goods go back to {wh}, revenue, VAT and cost are reversed, and the customer's balance goes to zero.

form.title: New quote
form.subtitle: Created with date {date} and list prices (before VAT).
form.errorLines: Add at least one line with a quantity.
form.errorDup: Some products are repeated: merge their quantities into one line.
form.note: A quote does not move inventory or accounting. Stock is checked when you invoice.

payment.title: Record payment for {doc}
payment.note: Recorded with date {date}: debits Banks and credits Customers.

inventory.title: Inventory by warehouse
inventory.subtitle: Stock and value at {date}. Click a SKU to see its stock card.
inventory.noInventoryLog: Montevera Logística provides storage services and has no inventory of its own. Choose “Surtidora Montevera” or the consolidated view.
inventory.periodSwitched: We switched the period to September 2026 so you can see the transaction.

toasts.poCreated: Purchase order {doc} created for {supplier}: approve it in Purchasing.

transfer.title: Warehouse transfer
transfer.subtitle: Move units from one warehouse to another at average cost.
transfer.errorQty: Enter a quantity greater than zero.
transfer.errorStock: Only {have} are available in the source warehouse.
transfer.note: A transfer does not change the total inventory value or post a journal entry; it does show up on each warehouse's stock card.

method.label: Valuation
method.totals: Total value: {avg} at weighted average · {fifo} at FIFO (difference {diff}).
method.policy: Accounting uses weighted average; FIFO is shown for comparison.

alerts.title: Reorder alerts
alerts.subtitle: Products below their reorder point at the cut-off date.
alerts.none: No products are below their reorder point.
alerts.inProgress: A PO is already in progress: {doc}
alerts.pastPeriod: You are viewing a closed period: actions are available in September 2026.

kardex.hint: Value and unit cost change with the selected valuation method.
kardex.title: Stock card for {sku}
kardex.subtitle: movements in the period, newest first
kardex.empty: This product had no movements in the period.
kardex.note: With “All warehouses”, transfers are hidden because they do not change the total balance.

purchases.title: Purchase orders
purchases.subtitle: Tiered approval, receipt with the supplier's invoice, and payment.
purchases.noPurchasesLog: Montevera Logística has no inventory purchases in this demo. Choose “Surtidora Montevera” or the consolidated view.
purchases.empty: No purchase orders in this view for the period.

rules.title: How it works
rules.level1: Every PO is approved by the purchasing manager.
rules.level2: If the total including VAT is {amount} or more, management approves it too.
rules.receive: On receipt, the goods enter the warehouse and the supplier invoice is booked (you can upload its XML to compare it with the PO).
rules.withholding: A {pct}% withholding tax is applied to the subtotal (sample rate).
rules.demoNote: In the demo you can approve at every level. In your project each level is approved by its assigned role, with the amounts you define.

toasts.approvedFinal: {doc} approved by {role}. You can now receive the goods.
toasts.approvedLevel: {doc} approved by {role}. Management approval is still needed.
toasts.received: {doc} received in {wh}: inventory and accounts payable were updated.
toasts.created: Purchase order {doc} created. Now approve it.

purchases.periodSwitched: We switched the period to September 2026 so you can see the transaction.

receive.title: Receive {doc}
receive.xmlHint: It is read in your browser and is not sent to any server. Accepts the (simplified) UBL 2.1 structure of the Colombian e-invoice.
receive.match: XML vs. PO comparison ({lines} lines in the XML)
receive.mismatch: The invoice does not match the PO. Check with the supplier, or receive without the XML by typing the invoice number.
receive.effect: On confirm: the goods enter {wh} (average cost updated) and the purchase entry is posted with input VAT, withholding and the payable.

errors.tooBig: The file is larger than 2 MB.
errors.notXml: The file is not valid XML.
errors.notInvoice: The XML is not a UBL invoice (no Invoice element).
errors.missing: The XML is missing the invoice number or the total.

reject.title: Reject {doc}
reject.placeholder: E.g.: price above the last purchase

form.title: New purchase order
form.subtitle: The proposed cost is each product's current average cost.
form.totals: Total incl. VAT {total} · {levels, plural, one {1 approval level} other {# approval levels}}
form.errorLines: Add at least one line with a quantity.
form.errorDup: Some products are repeated: merge their quantities into one line.
form.errorRaw: Raw materials and packaging are only received at the Bogotá warehouse (plant).

journal.title: General journal (PUC)
journal.subtitle: Double-entry postings generated by each transaction. Click a voucher to see its source.
journal.empty: There are no entries in this period.

manual.title: New manual entry
manual.subtitle: Adjustment voucher: debits must equal credits.
manual.note: Recorded on Sep 30, 2026 and immediately reflected in the trial balance and financial statements.
manual.errorLines: You need at least two lines with an amount.
manual.errorBoth: Each line must have a debit or a credit, not both.
manual.errorBalance: Debits and credits must be equal and greater than zero.

accounting.periodSwitched: We switched the period to September 2026 so you can see the transaction.

source.creditNote: Posted automatically by the credit note.
source.receipt: Posted automatically when recording the collection.
source.purchase: Posted automatically when receiving the purchase.
source.payment: Posted automatically when paying the supplier.
source.expense: Posted automatically by the expense accrual or bank movement.
source.tax: Posted automatically when paying the tax (account balance at cut-off).
source.prodStart: Posted automatically when starting the production order.
source.prodFinish: Posted automatically when finishing the production order.

trial.title: Trial balance
trial.subtitle: From {from} to {to}
trial.note: Debit balances are positive and credit balances negative. Closing balances always add up to zero.

pl.title: Income statement
pl.subtitle: From {from} to {to}
pl.ebitdaNote: Operating income + depreciation for the period ({dep}).
pl.taxNote: The income tax provision is a demo estimate and is not posted as an entry.

bs.title: Statement of financial position
bs.subtitle: At {date}
bs.note: Figures come from the same journal entries. In your project you can keep the books here or send the movements to your accounting software.

finance.periodSwitched: We switched the period to September 2026 so you can see the transaction.

cash.title: Cash flow
cash.subtitle: Monthly cash and bank inflows and outflows, calculated from the entries.
cash.aria: Chart of monthly inflows and outflows

ar.title: Receivables by customer
ar.subtitle: Invoices with a balance at {date}, sorted by overdue balance.

reminder.title: Payment reminder
reminder.text: Hello, {customer} team: this is {company} reaching out because you have {n, plural, one {1 overdue invoice} other {# overdue invoices}} for {amount}: {list}. Could you confirm the payment date? Thank you.
reminder.copyError: We could not copy the text; select it and copy it manually.
reminder.note: Simulated: the demo does not send anything. In your project the reminder is sent through WhatsApp Business or email, manually or on a schedule.

recon.title: Bank reconciliation
recon.subtitle: Bank statement lines for the period. Suggestions come from rules (reference, amount and customer name), not AI.
recon.nonePending: There are no pending lines to reconcile in this period.
recon.note: Demo statement lines are sample data. In your project you import your bank's Excel or CSV statements; a direct connection depends on each bank.

reasons.reference: the description includes the invoice number
reasons.amount: the amount equals the invoice balance
reasons.customer: the description includes the customer's name
reasons.outflow: it is a debit without a reference
reasons.noMatch: no invoice has that reference or amount

toasts.receipt: Collection recorded and reconciled: {doc} left receivables.
toasts.unidentified: Deposit recorded under “Advances received” until the customer is identified.

form.title: New production order
form.subtitle: It is created as planned; MRP takes it into account right away.

footer.sample: Sample data: Surtidora Montevera S.A.S. and Montevera Logística S.A.S. are fictitious companies; customers, suppliers, people, tax IDs and figures are made up.
footer.integrations: DIAN validation (e-invoice and electronic payroll), bank statements and WhatsApp reminders are simulated in the demo. In your project they connect to an authorized technology provider, your bank's statements, and WhatsApp Business or email.
footer.storage: What you do here is saved only in this browser, and you can reset it at any time.
